statement: After the exact charged-lepton cubic invariants are sealed, exact rational root brackets predict the squared adjacent-root mass ratios and compare them with the complete NIST CODATA 2022 muon-electron and muon-tau mass-ratio intervals.
title: Post-seal CODATA test of the charged-lepton cubic
